mechanism: Diltiazem inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes norethindrone, potentially increasing norethindrone levels and estrogen-related side effects; conversely, norethindrone may slightly increase diltiazem levels.
action: Monitor for increased estrogen-related adverse effects (nausea, headache, breakthrough bleeding); consider alternative contraception or increased diltiazem monitoring; counsel on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy in some cases.
